SELECT FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND quote_id=#{quoteId}
SELECT FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId}

mapper.sql: ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0 AND r.role_code IN ('MERCHANT_ADMIN','FINANCE_OPERATOR','WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR','CUSTOMER_SERVICE_OPERATOR')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_store_scope uss WHERE uss.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND uss.user_id=#{userId} AND uss.store_id=o.store_id AND uss.status='ACTIVE') )

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fee_adjustment fa WHERE fa.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND fa.shipment_order_id=o.id AND fa.confirmation_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REQUESTED'))

AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_address a WHERE a.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND a.shipment_order_id=o.id AND a.address_type='RECEIVER') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_address a WHERE a.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND a.shipment_order_id=o.id AND a.address_type='SENDER'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM shipment_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND AND o.current_status=#{status} AND o.store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM shipment_order o WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND AND o.current_status=#{status} AND o.store_id=#{storeId}
mapper.sql: o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.orderNo},'%') AND o.store_id=#{query.storeId} AND o.current_status=#{query.status} AND o.destination_country=#{query.destinationCountry} AND o.channel_id=#{query.channelId} AND o.created_at >= #{query.createdFrom} AND o.created_at <= #{query.createdTo} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM warehouse_outbound_record wor WHERE wor.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND wor.shipment_order_id=o.id AND wor.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.trackingNo},'%')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_tracking_event ste WHERE ste.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND ste.order_id=o.id AND ste.waybill_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.trackingNo},'%')))
mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.store_id,o.quote_id,o.current_status,o.destination_country,o.channel_id,COALESCE((SELECT wor.tracking_no FROM warehouse_outbound_record wor WHERE wor.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND wor.shipment_order_id=o.id),(SELECT ste.waybill_no FROM shipment_tracking_event ste WHERE ste.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND ste.order_id=o.id AND ste.waybill_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ste.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1)) tracking_no,o.estimated_fee,o.current_fee,o.confirmed_fee,o.currency,o.chargeable_weight,o.version,o.created_at FROM shipment_order o WHERE ORDER BY o.order_noo.current_statuso.destination_countryo.channel_ido.estimated_feeo.created_at ASCDESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{query.pageSize}

SELECT o.id,o.order_no,o.store_id,o.quote_id,o.current_status,o.destination_country,o.channel_id,COALESCE((SELECT wor.tracking_no FROM warehouse_outbound_record wor WHERE wor.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND wor.shipment_order_id=o.id),(SELECT ste.waybill_no FROM shipment_tracking_event ste WHERE ste.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND ste.order_id=o.id AND ste.waybill_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ste.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1)) tracking_no,o.estimated_fee,o.current_fee,o.confirmed_fee,o.currency,o.chargeable_weight,o.version,o.created_at FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.id IN #{id} ORDER BY o.order_noo.current_statuso.destination_countryo.channel_ido.estimated_feeo.created_at ASCDESC,o.id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT address_type,contact_name,company_name,phone,email,country_code,state_province,city,district,address_line1,address_line2,postal_code FROM shipment_address WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY address_type

SELECT id,package_no,declared_weight,declared_length,declared_width,declared_height,declared_volume_weight,declared_chargeable_weight,package_status FROM shipment_package WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT item_no,sku,product_name,quantity,unit_price,currency,declared_value,origin_country FROM shipment_item WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_package_id=#{packageId} ORDER BY item_no

SELECT id,adjustment_type,before_amount,after_amount,difference_amount,currency,reason,confirmation_status,requested_at,confirmed_at FROM fee_adjustment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT 'REWEIGHED' record_type,'COMPLETED' status,wm.actual_weight,wm.actual_length,wm.actual_width,wm.actual_height,wm.actual_chargeable_weight,NULL tracking_no,NULL location,wm.measured_at occurred_at FROM warehouse_measurement wm JOIN shipment_package sp ON sp.id=wm.shipment_package_id AND sp.tenant_id=wm.tenant_id WHERE wm.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sp.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT 'OUTBOUND','COMPLETED',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,wor.tracking_no,wor.batch_no,wor.outbound_at FROM warehouse_outbound_record wor WHERE wor.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND wor.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
SELECT status_code,title,description,location,source,occurred_at FROM shipment_tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT id,exception_no,exception_type,status,description,reported_at FROM exception_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY reported_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT event_type,title,description,status,source,location,occurred_at,trace_id FROM (SELECT CASE a.action_type WHEN 'CREATE' THEN 'CREATED' WHEN 'SUBMIT' THEN 'SUBMITTED' WHEN 'CANCEL' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE a.action_type END event_type,a.action_type title,a.reason description,a.result_status status,'AUDIT' source,NULL location,a.occurred_at,a.request_id trace_id FROM audit_log a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.resource_type='SHIPMENT_ORDER' AND a.resource_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT 'REWEIGHED','复称',NULL,'COMPLETED','WAREHOUSE',NULL,wm.measured_at,NULL FROM warehouse_measurement wm JOIN shipment_package sp ON sp.id=wm.shipment_package_id AND sp.tenant_id=wm.tenant_id WHERE wm.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sp.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT 'OUTBOUND','出库',wor.handover_remark,'COMPLETED','WAREHOUSE',wor.batch_no,wor.outbound_at,NULL FROM warehouse_outbound_record wor WHERE wor.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND wor.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT ste.status_code,ste.title,ste.description,ste.status_code,ste.source,ste.location,ste.occurred_at,NULL FROM shipment_tracking_event ste WHERE ste.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ste.order_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT 'FEE_ADJUSTED','费用调整',fa.reason,fa.confirmation_status,'FINANCE',NULL,COALESCE(fa.confirmed_at,fa.requested_at,fa.created_at),NULL FROM fee_adjustment fa WHERE fa.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND fa.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} UNION ALL SELECT 'EXCEPTION','异常',ec.description,ec.status,'EXCEPTION',NULL,ec.reported_at,NULL FROM exception_case ec WHERE ec.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ec.shipment_order_id=#{orderId}) timeline ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
SELECT id FROM shipment_package WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_address SET contact_name=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.contactName} ELSE #{receiver.contactName} END,phone=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.phone} ELSE #{receiver.phone} END,company_name=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.companyName} ELSE #{receiver.companyName} END,email=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.email} ELSE #{receiver.email} END,city=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.city} ELSE #{receiver.city} END,district=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.district} ELSE #{receiver.district} END,address_line1=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.addressLine1} ELSE #{receiver.addressLine1} END,address_line2=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.addressLine2} ELSE #{receiver.addressLine2} END,postal_code=CASE address_type WHEN 'SENDER' THEN #{sender.postalCode} ELSE #{receiver.postalCode} END WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId}
UPDATE shipment_order SET version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId} AND current_status='DRAFT' AND version=#{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE si FROM shipment_item si JOIN shipment_package sp ON sp.id=si.shipment_package_id WHERE si.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sp.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND sp.shipment_order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipment_item (tenant_id,shipment_package_id,item_no,product_name,product_name_en,quantity,unit_price,currency,declared_value,sku,origin_country) SELECT #{tenantId},id,#{itemNo},#{item.productName},#{item.productName},#{item.quantity},#{item.unitPrice},#{item.currency},#{item.unitPrice} * #{item.quantity},#{item.sku},#{item.countryOfOrigin} FROM shipment_package WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE shipment_order SET current_status=#{toStatus},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId} AND current_status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{version}
